rationale: Matches the ToOwned trait contract and precisely characterizes the result: the owned HashMap has the same deep-view (spec-level map) as the source reference. This is the strongest natural postcondition expressible with existing vstd vocabulary.
risks: Soundness depends on DeepView/DeepViewClone correctness for K and V (e.g., deep_clone must not introduce key collisions in the map's deep_view).
Assumes no hidden runtime state or nondeterminism in deep_clone/HashMap iteration that would violate deep-view equality.
